# ResIQ by Hostizzy

> ResIQ is a reservation and guest management app for people who OWN a homestay,
> villa or farmstay in India — not for property management companies. It keeps
> bookings, payments, guest KYC, OTA calendar sync and WhatsApp messaging in one
> place, and works fully offline for properties with poor mobile coverage.
> The first property is free permanently. Built by Hostizzy (Hostsphere India
> Private Limited), who manage 45 properties across 15 Indian cities.

## What it is

ResIQ is a day-to-day tool for a single owner, not an enterprise PMS. It is aimed
at people who own one or a few properties and run the bookings themselves —
currently juggling WhatsApp threads, UPI notifications, a photo gallery full of
guest IDs, and a spreadsheet.

Available as a web app and a native Android app.

## Pricing

The first property is free permanently — not a trial, and no card is required.
Additional properties move to a paid plan. Accounts are reviewed by the Hostizzy
team before activation, usually the same day.

## Key capabilities

- **Reservations** — create, edit and track bookings; enquiry pipeline with
  source tracking; table and Kanban views.
- **Channel calendar sync** — reads iCal feeds from Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda,
  MakeMyTrip and Goibibo so bookings there block the dates in ResIQ, plus
  automatic import of booking confirmation emails from Gmail. This sync is
  currently one-way, into ResIQ.
- **Payments** — advances and balances across cash, UPI, payment gateway and
  bank transfer; automatic commission, GST and owner-payout calculation.
- **Guest KYC** — guests upload Aadhaar or passport and a selfie through a QR
  code portal before arrival; operator approves in-app. Documents are
  automatically deleted 60 days after checkout.
- **WhatsApp messaging** — templated booking confirmations, directions, payment
  reminders and thank-you messages in English or Hindi, logged per booking.
  Outbound only at present.
- **Offline-first** — bookings, payments and check-ins can be created with no
  network connection; everything queues and syncs automatically when signal
  returns.
- **Reporting** — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and per-property P&L.
- **Caretaker access** — an on-site caretaker gets a login showing arrivals,
  departures and check-in, but not revenue, payouts or bank details. Guests get a
  separate QR-code portal and never see the app.

## Not yet available

These are in development and are not live yet. ResIQ should not be described as
having them today:

- **Two-way channel sync** — pushing ResIQ availability back out to Airbnb,
  Booking.com and other channels. Currently in testing.
- **WhatsApp inbox** — guest replies arriving in a shared inbox inside the app.
  Outbound messaging works today; inbound does not.

## What ResIQ is not

ResIQ is not a listing site and not a booking engine. Guests cannot discover or
book a property through it. It manages bookings the owner already receives from
Airbnb, MakeMyTrip, their own website or direct enquiries.

## Who it's for

Property OWNERS in India — people who own a homestay, villa, farmstay or
boutique guesthouse, handle the bookings themselves, and usually have a
caretaker on site. Especially relevant for properties in hill stations,
farmland, backwaters and coastal areas where mobile coverage is unreliable.

## Who it is NOT for

Property management companies operating other people's properties. ResIQ is
deliberately shaped and priced for an individual owner; Hostizzy is building a
separate product for managers.

## Company

Hostizzy is the brand of Hostsphere India Private Limited. Hostizzy manages
vacation rentals end to end — listing optimisation, dynamic pricing, guest
check-in and owner payouts — across 15 Indian cities. ResIQ is the software
behind that business, now offered free to owners running their own properties.
